day_shape: 51 items: Iran's response to US ceasefire text delivered via Pakistani mediator, UAE/Kuwait/Qatar report drone attacks and a Qatari tanker struck off its coast, IRGC navy threatens US assets, heavy regime channel volume, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Iran response to US ceasefire text
threads.summary: Iranian state media said Tehran's response to the latest US proposal to end the war was sent to the Pakistani mediator on Sunday. Defa Press and IRIB carried Foreign Ministry framing, while the Jerusalem Post reported the submission citing state media.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Gulf drone incidents
threads.summary: The Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported drone attacks reported by the UAE, Kuwait and Qatar, the UAE intercepting two Iranian drones, and a Qatari tanker struck 23 nautical miles off its coast. The IRGC navy threatened a 'heavy attack' on US assets if its oil tankers came under fire; Iranian MPs Nikzad and Azizi warned Gulf states against closing the Strait to themselves.

threads.label: Regime mobilisation and counter-intelligence messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted on the Khatam al-Anbiya commander reporting on armed forces readiness, while the Judiciary chief and an MP called for severe punishment of economic 'agitators' in wartime conditions. Defa Press and IRIB published images and details of two Mossad cells said to have been dismantled by the Ministry of Intelligence; Pezeshkian said negotiation does not mean surrender.

threads.label: Iranian economic and civilian strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported some medicine prices in Iran up as much as 400% with pharmacies struggling to supply critical drugs, citing a pharmacists' association official. The Jerusalem Post reported foreign militias deployed at Tehran checkpoints and Asian food production hit by the war; Air France suspended Dubai, Riyadh, Tel Aviv and Beirut flights to 20 May.

threads.label: Israeli political and legal fallout
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the High Court pressing the State Comptroller on his authority to examine October 7 and Iran-war failures, and a report of strain in the Trump–Netanyahu alliance after the Iran war did not deliver a quick victory. The Times of Israel reported a Likud minister claiming Hamas 'hatched' October 7 during the Bennett-Lapid government.

Russian President Vladimir Putin, following the parade ceremony, expressed condolences over the assassination of martyr Larijani. Putin, at a press conference amid journalists and media representatives, expressed condolences over the assassination of martyr Larijani, saying: Mr. Larijani, who unfortunately passed away, came to see me. It is truly regrettable; he was a person with whom one could have constructive dialogue, he listened well and was responsive. In another part of his remarks, the Russian President added: he said we have also changed our position and 'we are no longer willing to transfer this enriched uranium anywhere'.

events.title_en: World's strongest young weightlifter: I donated my medals to the martyrs of Minab
events.summary_en: World's strongest young weightlifter: I donated my medals to the martyrs of Minab. Hamidreza Mohammadi, the world's strongest young weightlifter, upon his return from the World Youth Weightlifting Championship competitions in Egypt, stated: I donated my three gold medals from international competitions to the students of Minab who were unjustly martyred. events.summary_en: Change in Iranian society's outlook towards negotiations with America. But today, nearly a decade later, that same society views the issue of negotiation differently. The reality is that the JCPOA was not merely a political agreement; rather, it had become a symbol of social hope. events.title_en: Baghaii: director general of the Atomic Energy Agency should refrain from politicking
events.summary_en: Baghaii: director general of the Atomic Energy Agency should refrain from politicking. The Foreign Ministry Spokesman, responding to remarks beyond the organisational authority of Rafael Grossi, Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency, regarding regional developments, wrote: the task of the International Atomic Energy Agency is verification, not sending political messages regarding the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's missiles or how Tehran should behave. When professional neutrality becomes a victim of political behaviour or personal ambitions, the credibility of institutions suffers erosion and soon afterwards their effectiveness is also compromised.
